question: Ubi Lakpi, a traditional game is played in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ubi Lakpi is a traditional game from the state of **Manipur**.
 
• This game is often played during the **Manipur New Year, locally known as Cheiraoba**.
 
• Ubi Lakpi translates to "Coconut Snatching" in the local Meitei language.
 
• The game resembles rugby, but instead of a ball, a greased coconut is used.
 
• It is a popular sport among the Meitei community and is played on special occasions and festivals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Traditional Sports in Manipur**

 
 
• Manipur is known for its rich heritage of traditional sports, including **Polo, locally known as Sagol Kangjei**.
 
• **Yubi Lakpi** is another traditional sport that showcases the athleticism and cultural significance of the Manipuri people.
 
• Another notable traditional sport is **Thang-Ta**, a martial art form that combines sword and spear techniques.
 
 
 
• **Cheiraoba Festival**
 
 
• Cheiraoba is the traditional New Year festival of the Meitei community in Manipur.
 
• It is celebrated with various cultural activities, including the playing of traditional games like Ubi Lakpi.
 
• Families prepare special dishes and offer them to deities, marking the beginning of a new year.
 
 
 
• **Meitei Community**
 
 
• The Meitei people are the predominant ethnic group of Manipur.
 
• They have a rich cultural heritage, including traditional dance forms like **Ras Leela** and sports like Ubi Lakpi.
 
• The Meitei language, also known as Manipuri, is recognized as one of the official languages of India.
